prospective_plan.comment: HH_260906 - Preregister a distinct frame-verified initialization-order comparison with every native failure retained.
prospective_plan.comparison_notice: Whole BasicAgent initialization-order experiment: constructor reads both current location and cached control after the verified existing full-brake bootstrap. Same global route, lateral numbers, pedal protocol, physics, cameras and safety thresholds; additional read-only observations have nonzero overhead. Not a steering-history-only causal proof.
expected_risks: Town07 passive-coast calibration may not transfer to C-track, even at the unchanged2.8..3.2m/s entry band; preserve early stop/overshoot/entry or time failures with no braking rescue.
Offline1m/2m curvature supports only target planning, not actual lateral dynamics, collision clearance, full future XY feasibility or training admission.
Keep exact native CARLA world height, base-to-actor conversion and actual map-projected terminal waypoint; never apply the downstream map z-minus15 to native spawn or sensors.

historical_before_bootstrap_reference.notice: Historical nonrandomized reference, not a fresh paired or independently randomized trial. Original failure and all observations remain unchanged.

review_measurements: all bootstrap/construction/engagement frame-bound snapshots and PID history
first proposed, sent and next observed steering with ACK sequence
all native20Hz acceleration and actual camera10Hz acceleration; both alternate20Hz offsets diagnostic only
all warmup, driving, tail, events and camera frames
maximum CTE, goal error, continuous low-speed stability and measured stop dwell
prospective_plan.after_first_trial: Review every recorded outcome before optional second attempt; no automatic retry, automatic pedal change, data admission or model deployment.

interpretation: A separate 14.4 km/h C-track left development diagnostic with historical C-track compact lookahead, not an identical-control Town07 comparison. All raw failures remain. Low-speed stability is measured 3.8..4.2 m/s for 5 seconds; the inherited base 30 km/h ceiling flag is only a loose upper bound, never 30 km/h cruise qualification. Exact native 20 Hz acceleration, stop/goal geometry and ACK evidence are independently recomputed. Camera byte hashes are not pixel approval. Timing files are preserved but not independently reconstructed here. No model, training, test payload, native coordinate rewrite or data admission.
